The quantification bar graph of relative invaded cells shows individual replicate data points (open circles) overlaid on the mean±SD bars.

Violin plots of TCGA RNA-seq data (n=240/187 patients) already display the full distribution of individual patient values; plotting hundreds of individual points is not required since the violin shape conveys the underlying distribution.

Kaplan-Meier survival curve is a cumulative statistic plot, not an average of replicate measurements, so individual data points are not applicable.
